answer: A concrete approach: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by pricing registration in scarce verifiable compute instead of free signups, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The jetty of work and the spiral of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a tide to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
